# Random HTML Canvas Game Idea

**Title:** Asteroid Dodge

**Concept:** The player controls a small ship that can move horizontally along the bottom of the canvas. Asteroids fall from the top at increasing speed. The player must dodge them by moving left or right.

**Lose Condition:** The game ends when an asteroid collides with the ship or reaches the bottom of the screen.

1: // Simple Asteroid Dodge game with enhanced graphics
2: // Targets <canvas id="game"></canvas>
3: 
4: const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
5: // Audio setup using Web Audio API
6: const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
7: function playBeep(freq, time) {
8:   const oscillator = audioCtx.createOscillator();
9:   const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
10:   oscillator.type = 'square';
11:   oscillator.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, audioCtx.currentTime);
12:   gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.1, audioCtx.currentTime);
13:   oscillator.connect(gain).connect(audioCtx.destination);
14:   oscillator.start();
15:   oscillator.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + time);
16: }
17: const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
18: canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 800;
19: canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 600;
20: 
21: // Pre‑generate star field for background
22: const stars = [];
23: for (let i = 0; i < 100; i++) {
24:   stars.push({
25:     x: Math.random() * canvas.width,
26:     y: Math.random() * canvas.height,
27:     radius: Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.5,
28:     alpha: Math.random() * 0.5 + 0.5
29:   });
30: }
31: 
32: function drawBackground() {
33:   // move stars slowly down for parallax effect
34:   for (const s of stars) {
35:     s.y += 0.2;
36:     if (s.y > canvas.height) s.y = 0;
37:   }
38: 
39:   ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
40:   ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
41:   ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
42:   for (const s of stars) {
43:     ctx.globalAlpha = s.alpha;
44:     ctx.beginPath();
45:     ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
46:     ctx.fill();
47:   }
48:   ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
49: }
50: 
51: // Ship definition – draw as a triangle with gradient
52: const ship = {
53:   width: 40,
54:   height: 20,
55:   x: canvas.width / 2 - 20,
56:   y: canvas.height - 30,
57:   speed: 5,
58:   moveLeft: false,
59:   moveRight: false,
60:   draw() {
61:     // draw ship as a gradient triangle
62:     const gradient = ctx.createLinearGradient(this.x, this.y, this.x + this.width, this.y + this.height);
63:     gradient.addColorStop(0, '#00ff00');
64:     gradient.addColorStop(1, '#006400');
65:     ctx.fillStyle = gradient;
66:     ctx.beginPath();
67:     ctx.moveTo(this.x, this.y + this.height);
68:     ctx.lineTo(this.x + this.width / 2, this.y);
69:     ctx.lineTo(this.x + this.width, this.y + this.height);
70:     ctx.closePath();
71:     ctx.fill();
72:   },
73:   update() {
74:     if (this.moveLeft) this.x = Math.max(0, this.x - this.speed);
75:     if (this.moveRight) this.x = Math.min(canvas.width - this.width, this.x + this.speed);
76:   }
77: };
78: 
79: // Asteroid pool
80: let asteroids = [];
81: let spawnTimer = 0;
82: let spawnInterval = 90; // frames
83: let speedFactor = 1;
84: let gameOver = false;
85: let score = 0;
86: 
87: function spawnAsteroid() {
88:   // play spawn sound
89:   playBeep(300, 0.02);
90:   const size = Math.random() * 30 + 20;
91:   asteroids.push({
92:     x: Math.random() * (canvas.width - size),
93:     y: -size,
94:     size,
95:     speed: 2 * speedFactor + Math.random() * 2
96:   });
97: }
98: 
99: function updateAsteroids() {
100:   for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
101:     const a = asteroids[i];
102:     a.y += a.speed;
103:     // remove if off screen
104:     if (a.y > canvas.height) {
105:       asteroids.splice(i, 1);
106:       score++;
107:       // gradually increase difficulty
108:       if (score % 10 === 0) speedFactor += 0.2;
109:     } else if (collision(a, ship)) {
110:       gameOver = true;
111:     }
112:   }
113: }
114: 
115: function drawAsteroids() {
116:   for (const a of asteroids) {
117:     const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(
118:       a.x + a.size / 2,
119:       a.y + a.size / 2,
120:       a.size * 0.1,
121:       a.x + a.size / 2,
122:       a.y + a.size / 2,
123:       a.size / 2
124:     );
125:     grad.addColorStop(0, '#bbb');
126:     grad.addColorStop(1, '#555');
127:     ctx.fillStyle = grad;
128:     ctx.beginPath();
129:     ctx.arc(a.x + a.size / 2, a.y + a.size / 2, a.size / 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
130:     ctx.fill();
131:   }
132: }
133: 
134: function collision(ast, shp) {
135:   const collided = (
136:     ast.x < shp.x + shp.width &&
137:     ast.x + ast.size > shp.x &&
138:     ast.y < shp.y + shp.height &&
139:     ast.y + ast.size > shp.y
140:   );
141:   if (collided) {
142:     // play crash sound
143:     playBeep(100, 0.3);
144:   }
145:   return collided;
146: }
147:   return (
148:     ast.x < shp.x + shp.width &&
149:     ast.x + ast.size > shp.x &&
150:     ast.y < shp.y + shp.height &&
151:     ast.y + ast.size > shp.y
152:   );
153: }
154: 
155: function drawScore() {
156:   ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
157:   ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
158:   ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, 10, 20);
159: }
160: 
161: function gameLoop() {
162:   if (gameOver) {
163:     // Dark overlay for game over
164:     ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
165:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
166:     ctx.fillStyle = '#ff4444';
167:     ctx.font = '30px sans-serif';
168:     ctx.textAlign = 'center';
169:     ctx.fillText('Game Over', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2);
170:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
171:     ctx.font = '20px sans-serif';
172:     ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2 + 30);
173:     ctx.textAlign = 'left';
174:     return;
175:   }
176: 
177:   // draw starry background
178:   drawBackground();
179: 
180:   ship.update();
181:   ship.draw();
182: 
183:   if (spawnTimer++ >= spawnInterval) {
184:     spawnAsteroid();
185:     spawnTimer = 0;
186:     // slightly speed up spawns
187:     if (spawnInterval > 30) spawnInterval -= 0.5;
188:   }
189: 
190:   updateAsteroids();
191:   drawAsteroids();
192:   drawScore();
193: 
194:   requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);
195: }
196: 
197: // Input handling
198: window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
199:   // Ensure audio context is running
200:   if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') audioCtx.resume();
201:   if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') ship.moveLeft = true;
202:   if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') ship.moveRight = true;
203: });
204: window.addEventListener('keyup', e => {
205:   if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') ship.moveLeft = false;
206:   if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') ship.moveRight = false;
207: });
208: 
209: // Start game
210: requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);

(End of file - total 210 lines)
</content>
